payload.friendly_name: Pack item ETags and resolver retirement
payload.purpose_context: Clients can use one rule for pack-scoped reads: each read of a single thing names the pack revision it was read at. The service also drops a component resolver path no request reaches, so its code says what the live graph walks do (issues #487 and #488).
payload.purpose_tldr: Every pack read of one artifact carries the pack revision as its ETag, and an unused graph-walk path is removed.

payload.question: Confirm the Intent Summary for #487 and #488 as stated
Confirm the Engineering Alignment, incl. carrying the pack revision only on the pack-scoped mission-type holding read

payload.wp_title: Retire the resolver's unused walk path
Tactic and mission step contract items carry the revision
Contract and scenarios: every pack read of one thing carries the revision
Mission type, step and skeleton pack reads carry the revision
